full_text:
Article 8 (Recommendation and Reporting of Special Prosecutor Candidates)
(1) The Committee shall recommend in writing to the President two candidates for special prosecutor from among persons who meet the qualifications under Article 3 (2) of the Act and are not subject to any of the grounds for disqualification under the subparagraphs of Article 5 of the Act.
(2) Where the Committee resolves to recommend special prosecutor candidates, it shall immediately report the result to the Speaker of the National Assembly.
